info.name: Increase Account Numbers Routing Numbers API

items.docs: You can use this API to confirm if a routing number is valid, such as when a user is providing you with bank account details. Since routing numbers uniquely identify a bank, this will always return 0 or 1 entry. In Sandbox, only a few [routing numbers are valid](/documentation/sandbox-test-values#routing-numbers). `110000000` is an example of a Sandbox routing number.
